title: Insecure Data Sharing
description: The parent user may inadvertently share sensitive information (email, password, name, govt ID) in an insecure manner, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Interception
description: Data in transit (registration details) could be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to personal information.

title: Improper Data Storage
description: The Authentication Service may store sensitive user data (email, password, name, govt ID) insecurely, making it vulnerable to data breaches.

title: Unintended Data Disclosure
description: The Authentication Service may unintentionally disclose user data to unauthorized parties due to misconfigurations or inadequate access controls.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The authentication service may not obtain explicit consent from the parent account holder before storing their information in the MongoDB users collection, leading to a lack of transparency regarding data usage.

title: Data Breach Risk
description: The stored parent account information in the MongoDB users collection is susceptible to unauthorized access or data breaches, which could expose sensitive personal information.

title: Insufficient Data Minimization
description: The authentication service may store more information than necessary about the parent account, violating principles of data minimization.

title: Unclear Data Retention Policy
description: The MongoDB users collection may not have a clear data retention policy, leading to indefinite storage of parent account information without justification.

title: Data Leakage through JWT
description: The authentication service may inadvertently expose sensitive user data embedded in the JWT if proper encryption or signing mechanisms are not implemented, leading to unauthorized access to user information.

title: Identity Theft
description: The parent user may be at risk of identity theft if the JWT is intercepted or if the user data is mishandled after receipt, allowing attackers to impersonate the user.

title: Non-repudiation Issues
description: If the JWT is not properly logged or if there is no mechanism to verify the authenticity of the data flow, it may lead to non-repudiation issues, where the parent user cannot prove that they did not authorize a transaction or action.

title: Insecure Data Sharing
description: The child user shares sensitive information (parent email and password) which could be intercepted by an unauthorized party during transmission.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: The data flow may expose metadata about the child user and the parent email during the authentication process.

title: Unauthorized Access to Data
description: The authentication service may store or process the parent email and password insecurely, leading to unauthorized access.

title: User Misidentification
description: The authentication service may incorrectly identify the child user due to weak authentication mechanisms, allowing unauthorized access.

title: Insufficient Authentication Mechanism
description: The authentication service may not implement strong enough mechanisms to verify the identity of the child user, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive child profiles.

title: Inadequate Data Protection at Destination
description: Once the child user receives the JWT and profiles, there may be insufficient measures in place to protect this data from unauthorized access or disclosure.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: The JWT and child profiles may be intercepted during transmission, leading to potential data leakage and exposure of sensitive information.

title: Improper Data Storage Practices
description: The child profiles may be stored insecurely by the child user, leading to potential unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The parent user may not have provided adequate consent for the collection of sensitive information about the child, such as government ID and date of birth.

title: Data Misuse
description: The child profile management process may misuse the collected data for purposes other than those originally intended, such as marketing or profiling.

title: Data Leakage
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of sensitive information from the parent user to the child profile management process, potentially exposing it to unauthorized parties.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The child profile management process may store sensitive data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Inadequate Consent Management
description: The process may not adequately manage consent from parents or guardians for storing and updating child profiles, leading to unauthorized data processing.

title: Data Breach Risk
description: The MongoDB childprofiles collection may be vulnerable to data breaches, exposing sensitive child profile information to unauthorized parties.

title: Inadequate Data Retention Policies
description: The data stored in the MongoDB collection may not have adequate retention policies, leading to unnecessary storage of personal data beyond its intended purpose.

title: Unintended Data Sharing
description: The child profile data may be unintentionally shared with third parties due to misconfigurations or lack of proper access controls in the MongoDB database.

title: Informed Consent
description: The child user may not fully understand the implications of sharing their data with the Video Management Service, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Inference
description: The Video Management Service may infer sensitive information about the child user based on their video search, requests, likes, and comments.

title: Data Leakage
description: Metadata about the child's interactions (searches, likes, comments) could be intercepted during transmission, leading to potential identification of the child.

title: Data Retention
description: The Video Management Service may retain the child's data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Unintended Use of Data
description: The Video Management Service may use the child's data for purposes beyond what was originally intended or communicated.

title: Unauthorized Access to Video Metadata
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the video metadata being shared by the Video Management Service, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Insecure Storage of Video Files
description: The MongoDB videos collection may not implement adequate security measures, leading to potential data breaches and unauthorized access to sensitive video files.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The video metadata and files may be retained longer than necessary, leading to potential privacy concerns regarding the storage of personal data.

title: Data Disclosure to Third Parties
description: There is a risk that the video metadata and files could be disclosed to third parties without proper consent, violating user privacy.

title: Inadequate Consent Management
description: The process may not adequately inform parents or guardians about the data being collected, leading to a lack of informed consent for storing child search and watch history.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The MongoDB childprofiles collection may retain child search and watch history longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or misuse.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The child profiles stored in MongoDB may be vulnerable to unauthorized access if proper security measures are not implemented.

title: Metadata Leakage
description: During the data flow from the Child Profile Management process to the MongoDB collection, metadata about the child profiles could be intercepted, revealing sensitive information.

title: Inadequate User Consent
description: The parent user may upload videos without fully understanding the implications of sharing their content, leading to potential misuse of their data.

title: Data Misuse by Service Provider
description: The Video Management Service may misuse the uploaded videos for purposes other than what the parent user intended, such as selling data to third parties.

title: Data Interception during Upload
description: Data being uploaded may be intercepted by unauthorized parties, leading to potential privacy breaches.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: Uploaded videos may be stored insecurely, making them vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Unauthorized Access to Video Stream
description: A child user may gain unauthorized access to video streams that are not intended for them, leading to exposure of inappropriate content.

title: Inappropriate Content Exposure
description: The child user may be exposed to inappropriate content if the video management service fails to adequately filter or restrict access to certain videos.

title: Data Leakage During Streaming
description: Metadata about the child user or the video being streamed could be intercepted during transmission, leading to potential identification or profiling of the child user.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The child browsing data may be shared with unauthorized parties without proper consent, leading to potential misuse of sensitive information.

title: Inaccurate Data Processing
description: The AI Recommendation Engine may process the child browsing data inaccurately, leading to inappropriate recommendations or actions based on flawed data interpretation.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The AI Recommendation Engine may retain child browsing data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of data breaches or unauthorized access.

title: Network Eavesdropping
description: Data in transit from the MongoDB childprofiles collection to the AI Recommendation Engine may be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Inadequate Consent Management
description: The AI Recommendation Engine may share browsing data with third-party advertisers without obtaining proper consent from users, leading to unauthorized data sharing.

title: Data Misuse by Advertisers
description: Third-party advertisers may misuse the browsing data for purposes other than what was originally intended, such as profiling or targeting without user knowledge.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Browsing data may be intercepted during transmission to third-party advertisers, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Insecure Data Storage by Advertisers
description: Third-party advertisers may store the browsing data insecurely, making it vulnerable to breaches and unauthorized access.

title: Unauthorized Access to Government ID Images
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the authentication service and submit a request to store government ID images, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Insecure Storage of Government ID Images
description: The file system may not have adequate security measures in place, leading to unauthorized access or data leaks of sensitive government ID images.

title: Data Interception During Transmission
description: Data being transmitted from the authentication service to the file system could be intercepted by malicious actors, exposing sensitive government ID images.

title: Insufficient Authentication Strength
description: The authentication service may use weak algorithms or insufficiently complex passwords, making it easier for attackers to gain unauthorized access to the JWT stored in localStorage.

title: Insecure Storage of JWT
description: Storing JWT in localStorage can expose it to cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks, where malicious scripts can access the token and impersonate the user.

title: Data Leakage through LocalStorage
description: The JWT stored in localStorage may be accessible to other scripts running on the same domain, leading to potential data leakage if those scripts are compromised.

title: Unauthorized Access to Child Profile
description: A parent may gain unauthorized access to sensitive child profile information if proper authentication mechanisms are not in place.

title: Inadequate Data Protection at Destination
description: Once the child profile data is received by the parent, there may be inadequate measures to protect the data from unauthorized access or sharing.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of child profile data to the parent, potentially exposing sensitive information to unauthorized parties.

title: Misuse of Child Profile Data
description: The parent may misuse the child profile data for purposes other than intended, such as sharing it with third parties without consent.
